about: Fuxi reviewed pairings for tools/ios27-prelink.py --pairs (K2, docs-lanes/ios27.md). Inputs: the 24A446 j820 kernelcache (sha256 below) and a Fuxi xnu-12377 kernel. Each original address is an unmatched kernel target that a prelinked kext calls or references. Evidence comes from function-start order and sizes in the original kernel, symbol order in our RELEASE LTO reference build, and the public xnu-12377.121.6 source; no Apple code is reproduced. Confidence: high = same position and layout, medium = order only. Darwin 26 additions that our source lacks stay unpaired (stubbed).

0xfffffe000b412984.name: __ZN8OSSymbol11withCStringEPKc
0xfffffe000b412984.evidence: OSSymbol.cpp order withString, withCString, withCStringNoCopy, existingSymbolForString, existingSymbolForCString; three unbound originals sit between withString and existingSymbolForCString, and this is the first. x0 at the call is a C string. The matcher bound the next one (540 bytes, call-sites) to withCString too; a copying symbol is a safe superset of NoCopy.
